api: FloatingText.Spawn(Vector3 worldPos, string text, Color color)
animation: rises 0.5 world-unit, fades alpha 1->0, duration 1.0s, Time.unscaledDeltaTime
font: Unity built-in Arial (Resources.GetBuiltinResource) — no external asset required
bootstrap: [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] hidden DontDestroyOnLoad FloatingTextHost GO, FindFirstObjectByType idempotency guard
flags_for_qa: FloatingText.Spawn exists and is callable. Console test: FloatingText.Spawn(Camera.main.transform.position + Vector3.up, "-5", Color.red)
Call-sites (arrow hit -> red '-N', harvest -> '+N wood') are a follow-up wave — not wired in this file
TextMesh uses Unity built-in Arial (Arial.ttf via Resources.GetBuiltinResource) — no .meta/font/material import needed at runtime
sortingOrder 50 places text above all known layers (pawns 9-11, bars 29-31, NightOverlay 25) — confirm no UI Canvas z-fighting in player build
FloatingTextHost is an internal sealed MonoBehaviour on the hidden host GO; it is what FindFirstObjectByType targets for idempotency
wiki_b6_acceptance: An arrow hit (or QA-invoked Spawn) produces a colored number that rises and fades over ~1s above the target
